svg.text: BARRY HARRIS 6TH-DIMINISHED · THE SCALE OF CHORDS
ONE 6th chord cycles all four inversions while ONE diminished-7th rotates in between — every scale tone is just one face of these two chords.

g.text: × muted · middle 4 strings (A-D-G-B), CAGED A-shape, root on A string

svg.text: The 24 columns above are just these two chords — the 6th/7th walking its inversions, the °7 rotating.
same notes C E G A — the bass walks up through the chord
C6/A = Am7 — that is why every m7 chord is also a 6th chord in disguise.
dim7 is symmetrical — 4 spellings, 1 collection B D F Ab
The °7 spine is the rootless V7♭9 / vii°7 — it never changes between rows.
